quandoUsar: Headers and toolbars where an always-open search field would crowd the layout.
Searching a set that is already on the client (projects, documents, people), with results grouped by `group` right below the field.
When it is worth suggesting something before typing: `suggestions` appears as soon as the field opens, under the `suggestionsLabel` heading.
quandoEvitar: Use `search-field` when search is the screen's main action and should always be visible as a field.
Use `command-palette` when the results are commands with shortcuts, not items to open.
Use `morphing-search` when you need to control the text and the opening from outside or open the search with a keyboard shortcut: here the query and state are internal.

teclado.acao: On the magnifier button, open the field and move focus to it.
Move the highlight through the results or suggestions, wrapping around at the ends.
In the field, chooses the highlighted item, calls `onSelect`, and collapses the search.
Collapses the field back to the icon, clears the text, and returns focus to the button.

acessibilidade: Collapsed, it is a `<button>` named by `label`; open, the field is a `role="combobox"` with `aria-activedescendant`, and the results form a `role="listbox"` with labeled groups.
A `role="status"` region announces the number of results or the lack of them in fixed English (`3 results`, `No results for …`); `emptyHint` and `suggestionsLabel` are translatable via props.
When typing, the first result is already highlighted, so `Enter` chooses it; leaving the empty field collapses it, and the clear button stays outside the tab order.
movimento: The round button stretches into the field with a spring, and the corner radius follows the width, from circle to control radius.
The panel unfolds from the field and then only the height follows the content; rows slide to the new position when the list changes and the highlight travels from one row to another.
With “reduce motion” on, the width changes instantly and panel and results only fade.
responsivo: Takes 100% of the container width as a strip that does not intercept clicks; the field grows up to `expandedWidth` (default 360 px) or the width of that strip, whichever is smaller.
The results panel scrolls inside above `min(22rem, 60vh)`, and long titles are cut with an ellipsis.
desempenho: The search scans all of `items` on every key, but only `maxResults` rows (default 6) are rendered; two `ResizeObserver`s track the strip and the panel.
notasIA: Put it in a container with the width the field may take and choose `anchor` (`start` or `end`, default `end`) to say which edge the button sits on.
`label` is required; each item is `{ id, title, meta?, group?, icon?, keywords? }`, and the order of the groups follows the first appearance of each one in `items`.
The text and the open state are internal: react to `onSelect(item)` and `onExpandedChange`; the search is local, looks at `title`, `meta`, and `keywords`, and is case-insensitive.
